criteria.requirement: Extend only the builtin regex format registration to catch declared regular-expression compilation failures: re.error, ValueError for incompatible inline flags, RecursionError for bounded deeply nested patterns and OverflowError for repeat limits. FormatChecker.check must produce FormatError retaining cause and real format validation must yield ValidationError instead of leaking those failures. Preserve empty/valid patterns and nonstring JSON Schema format semantics. Never catch arbitrary BaseException or broaden unrelated custom checker programming-error handling.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
